critical_code_review_comments: OperationCard.jsx origin-pill detection (lines 402-414) still parses backend semantic data out of free-text notes. Recommend the backend expose a clean `source` enum field (pos | vehicle_visit_sync | general) on GET /api/operations so the UI does not need a regex + multi-substring fallback. The current fix works but is fragile: any future change to the SmartPOSJournal notes marker would silently break the badge again. A simple test_pos_origin_marker pytest in backend_tests would close the loop.

rca_of_the_issue.primary_bug: RESOLVED — the iter218 frontend bug (POS badge never renders for POS-created operations) was caused by detection condition only matching '[pos]' substring while backend writes the marker as '[SOURCE:SMART_POS]' inside notes. Fix in OperationCard.jsx adds `opNotesStr.includes('smart_pos')` and the regex /\[source:[^\]]*pos[^\]]*\]/i which both match the real backend marker. Verified against real DB rows 339be01c and 9a48d961.
